findings.title: setCustomizing returns true even when state unchanged ambiguous
findings.message: On palette exit the ObjC side calls the scope function with customizing=0, but the Go return value is ignored. Separately, setCustomizing(true) returns false when the state is already customizing (via no-op), so the ObjC runCustomizationPalette path can return early while a palette is already considered running. A reentrant or repeated call mismatches Go and native state; permission could stay revoked.
findings.suggestion: Make setCustomizing return true when the requested state is already satisfied, or have the native side distinguish refused from unchanged.
